styleOnlyReference.role: Style-only reference for clean cel shading; no tower motifs or objects are copied.

candidates.prompt: Use case: style-transfer. Asset type: full-bleed 16:9 ground texture behind a mobile fantasy tower-defense arena. Input images: Image 1 is the EDIT TARGET, the existing purple-gray outer arena floor; Image 2 is STYLE-ONLY reference for clean, polished, broad cel-shaded shapes and restrained finish. Primary request: edit Image 1 into a noticeably simpler and quieter purple/indigo stone floor. Make the stone planes dramatically larger with far fewer seams, broad two-tone cel shading, soft low-contrast joins, and generous calm surfaces that keep gameplay elements readable. Keep the target's landscape 16:9 frame, near-overhead view, full-bleed ground coverage, purple/indigo family and functional role as the OUTER ground beyond the road. Preserve uniform quiet visual weight across the whole frame; edges should be usable after scaling/cropping. Do not copy the tower or add blue crystals. Avoid roads, center board, sockets, pillars, braziers, props, characters, text, runes, vignettes, grids, tiny stones, brick microdetail, scratch/noise texture, bright highlights, visible repetitive motifs. Deliver one finished raster image, no presentation mockup.

candidates.runtimeDecision: The candidate repeated visibly at 256px, so the final game renderer paints it once with a centered cover crop. The prompt below records the original generation request.
candidates.prompt: Use case: style-transfer. Asset type: square REPEATING surface texture for the inner tower-placement board of a mobile fantasy tower-defense arena. Input images: Image 1 is the EDIT TARGET, existing dark purple inner-board stone texture; Image 2 is STYLE-ONLY reference for clean, polished broad cel shading. Primary request: edit Image 1 into a much quieter, simpler inner-board texture: very large, broad dark indigo-violet stone planes, only sparse faint organic boundaries, nearly flat two-tone cel shading, no grit. Keep it recognizably darker and calmer than the outer purple floor, so towers and purple-gold sockets read clearly above it. Preserve a square, full-bleed, straight overhead texture with consistent color and lighting everywhere. Crucial repeat requirement: this image will be shrunk to a 256×256 tile and repeated across a 444×244 board; make opposite edges meet visually, avoid cropped high-contrast shapes or line endings at image borders, avoid center spotlight, gradient, frame or corners. Image 2 does not contribute objects: do not add tower, crystals, gold trim, or gameplay objects. Avoid cracks, brick grids, small stones, noise/microtexture, runes, sockets, road, border, text, characters, props, watermark. Deliver one finished raster square tile, no presentation mockup.
